name: Victini
flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
notes: No change.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Servine
flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

name: Serperior
flavorText: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott
flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

name: Samurott
flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Lillipup
flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

name: Herdier
flavorText: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

name: Stoutland
flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

name: Purrloin
flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

name: Liepard
flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

name: Pansage
flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

name: Simisage
flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Pansear
flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

name: Simisear
flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

name: Panpour
flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Munna
flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

name: Musharna
flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Pidove
flavorText: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

name: Tranquill
flavorText: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.

name: Unfezant
flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
statChangeNote: Attack and Special Attack switched as well as +5 HP, +5 Special Attack, +5 Speed

name: Blitzle
flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

name: Zebstrika
flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Roggenrola
flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
statChangeNote: *The Roggenrola line has had their playstyle changed to set itself apart from its Kantopart Geodude, they are still potent physical attackers but they now lean more into the Special side

name: Boldore
flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
statChangeNote: *The Roggenrola line has had their playstyle changed to set itself apart from its Kantopart the Geodude line, they are still potent physical attackers but they now lean more into the Special side.
notes: Now evolves into Gigalith at Level 40.

name: Gigalith
flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
statChangeNote: *The Roggenrola line has had their playstyle changed to set itself apart from its Kantopart the Geodude line, they are still potent physical attackers but they now lean more into the Special side.

name: Woobat
flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
notes: Can now learn TM83 Work Up via TM

name: Swoobat
flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
notes: Can now learn TM83 Work Up via TM

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Excadrill
flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Audino
flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
notes: Can learn TM39 Rock Tomb via TM Can learn TM94 Rock Smash via TM Can learn HM04 Strength via TM

name: Timburr
flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr
flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
notes: Now evolves into Conkeldurr at Level 40

name: Conkeldurr
flavorText: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

name: Tympole
flavorText: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

name: Palpitoad
flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Seismitoad
flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
notes: Can learn TM13 Ice Beam via TM (RomHack) Can learn HM05 Waterfall via HM (RomHack)

name: Throh
flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
abilityNotes: *Mold Breaker is now a standard ability
notes: No change.

name: Sawk
flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
notes: No change.

name: Sewaddle
flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

name: Swadloon
flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
notes: Can learn TM47 Low Sweep via TM (RomHack) Can learn TM31 Brick Break Via TM (RomHack)

name: Venipede
flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

name: Whirlipede
flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
notes: Has a 50% chance of holding a Pecha Berry Has a 5% chance of holding a Poison Barb

name: Scolipede
flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

name: Cottonee
flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
notes: Can learn TM33 Reflect via TM (RomHack) *5% chance of holding a Salac berry

name: Whimsicott
flavorText: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
notes: Can Learn TM33 Reflect via TM (RomHack) *5% chance of holding a Salac Berry

name: Petilil
flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
notes: Can learn TM59 Echoed Voice via TM (RomHack) *Has a 5% chance of holding a Petaya Berry

name: Lilligant
flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
notes: Can learn TM59 Echoed Voice via TM (RomHack) Can Learn TM52 Focus Blast via TM (RomHack) *Has a 5% chance of holding a Petaya Berry

name: Basculin
flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
statChangeNote: +20 Attack, -10 Defense, +10 Special Attack, -10 Special Defense

name: Sandile
flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
abilityNotes: *Zen Mode is exclusive to the static Darmanitan in Desert Resort

name: Maractus
flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
abilityNotes: *Storm Drain is now a standard ability
notes: Can learn TM75 Swords Dance Via TM (RomHack)

name: Dwebble
flavorText: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

name: Crustle
flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
notes: Now evolves into Scrafty at Level 32

name: Scrafty
flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

name: Sigilyph
flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

name: Yamask
flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Cofagrigus
flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Tirtouga
flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

name: Carracosta
flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

name: Archen
flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

name: Archeops
flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: Zorua
flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Minccino
flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

name: Cinccino
flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

name: Gothita
flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

name: Gothitelle
flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Solosis
flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Duosion
flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

name: Reuniclus
flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

name: Ducklett
flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
notes: Ducklett now evolves into Swanna at Level 30

name: Swanna
flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Vanillite
flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
abilityNotes: *Weak Armor is now a standard ability
notes: Now evolves into Vanillish at level 32

name: Vanillish
flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
abilityNotes: *Weak Armor is now a standard ability
notes: Now evolves into Vanilluxe at level 41

name: Vanilluxe
flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
abilityNotes: *Weak Armor is now a standard ability

name: Deerling
flavorText: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
notes: Now evolves into Sawsbuck at Level 31

name: Sawsbuck
flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
notes: Now learns TM78 Bulldoze via TM (Romhack) *Has a 5% chance of holding a Liechi Berry

name: Emolga
flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
abilityNotes: *Motor Drive is now a standard ability
notes: Can now learn TM53 Energy Ball via TM Can now learn HM02 Fly via HM

name: Karrablast
flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
notes: Now evolves into Escavalier while levelling up with a Shelmet in the party

name: Escavalier
flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

name: Foongus
flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
notes: Now evolves into Amoonguss at level 33 *Has a 5% chance of holding an Apicot berry

name: Amoonguss
flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
notes: Can learn TM84 Poison Jab via TM (RomHack) *Has a 5% chance of holding a Apicot Berry

name: Frillish
flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

name: Jellicent
flavorText: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

name: Alomomola
flavorText: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
statChangeNote: -15 Attack, +50 Special Attack, Special Defense and Speed are switched
notes: *Has a 50% chance of holding a Heart Scale.

name: Joltik
flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
statChangeNote: +20 Attack, -10 Defense, +20 Special Attack, -10 Special Defense, +10 Speed

name: Galvantula
flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
notes: *Has a 5% chance of holding a Ganlon Berry

name: Ferrothorn
flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
notes: *Has a 5% chance of holding a Ganlon Berry

name: Tynamo
flavorText: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
notes: Now evolves into Eelektrik at Level 35

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
notes: Can learn HM03 Surf via HM Can learn HM05 Waterfall via HM

name: Eelektross
flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
notes: Can learn TM78 Bulldoze via TM Can learn HM03 Surf via HM Can learn HM05 Waterfall via HM

name: Elgyem
flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
notes: Now evolves into Beheeyem at Lvl 39

name: Beheeyem
flavorText: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
notes: Now evolves into Lampent at Level 35

name: Lampent
flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

name: Chandelure
flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Axew
flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Fraxure
flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
abilityNotes: Unnerve is now a standard ability

name: Haxorus
flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
abilityNotes: * Unnerve is now a standard ability

name: Cubchoo
flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

name: Beartic
flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
abilityNotes: *Swift Swim is now a standard ability
notes: Can learn TM26 Earthquake Via TM (Gen 9) Can learn HM05 Waterfall via TM (Romhack)

name: Cryogonal
flavorText: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
notes: Now cannot learn TM45 Attract via TM (Cryogonal is a proud Enby Ace) Can learn TM57 Charge Beam via TM (RomHack)

name: Shelmet
flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
notes: Now evolves into Accelgor when leveled up with a Karrablast in the party

name: Accelgor
flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Mienfoo
flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
notes: Now evolves into Mienshao at Level 37

name: Mienshao
flavorText: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Druddigon
flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: Golett
flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
abilityNotes: No Guard is now a standard Ability
notes: Now evolves into Golurk at Level 40

name: Golurk
flavorText: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
abilityNotes: No Guard is now a Standard ability

name: Pawniard
flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
notes: Now evolves into Bisharp at Level 42

name: Bisharp
flavorText: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

name: Bouffalant
flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
notes: Now evolves into Braviary at Level 36

name: Braviary
flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
notes: Now evolves into Mandibuzz at level 36

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

name: Heatmor
flavorText: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
abilityNotes: *White Smoke is now a Standard ability

name: Durant
flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Deino
flavorText: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
notes: Now evolves into Zweilous at level 40

name: Zweilous
flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
notes: Now Evolves into Hydreigon at Level 58

name: Hydreigon
flavorText: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

name: Larvesta
flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
notes: Now evolves into Volcarona at Level 43

name: Volcarona
flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Cobalion
flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

name: Terrakion
flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

name: Virizion
flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

name: Tornadus
flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Thundurus
flavorText: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Zekrom
flavorText: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

name: Landorus
flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
abilityNotes: Sheer Force is now the standard ability

name: Kyurem
flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
notes: *Aqua Step is exclusively learnt in battle while in Pirouette forme. You can still use a Heart Scale to reteach Torch Song though!

name: Genesect
flavorText: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

name: Ivysaur
flavorText: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.

name: Venusaur
flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

name: Charizard
flavorText: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
statChangeNote: +21 Attack, -6 Defense, -9 Special Attack, -5 Special Defense

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Blastoise
flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

name: Caterpie
flavorText: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
abilityNotes: *Run away is now a standard ability

name: Metapod
flavorText: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

name: Butterfree
flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
abilityNotes: *Tinted Lens is now a standard ability

name: Weedle
flavorText: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
abilityNotes: *Run Away is now a standard ability

name: Kakuna
flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavorText: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

name: Pidgey
flavorText: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
abilityNotes: *Big Pecks is now a standard ability
statChangeNote: +10 HP, +5 Attack, +5 Defense, +10 Special Attack, +5 Special Defense

name: Pidgeotto
flavorText: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
abilityNotes: *Big Pecks is now a standard ability

name: Pidgeot

flavorText: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

name: Phanpy

name: Donphan
flavorText: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

name: Porygon2
flavorText: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.

name: Stantler
flavorText: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

flavorText: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

flavorText: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.

flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

abilityNotes: *Flash Fire is now a standard ability

flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
abilityNotes: *Water Absorb is now a standard ability

flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

name: Lugia
flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Sceptile

flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

name: Blaziken
flavorText: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.

flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Marshtomp
flavorText: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

name: Swampert
flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

name: Poochyena
flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

flavorText: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.

name: Seedot
flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

name: Tailow
flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

flavorText: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.

flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

name: Ralts
flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gardevoir
flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Surskit
flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

name: Masquerain

statChangeNote: +30 Special Attack (Including Later gen buff) +20 Speed (Including Later gen buff)

flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

name: Vigoroth
flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

name: Slaking
flavorText: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

name: Nincada
flavorText: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

name: Ninjask
flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

flavorText: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.

flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Exploud
flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

flavorText: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

flavorText: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

flavorText: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.

flavorText: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

flavorText: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.

flavorText: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.
statChangeNote: +25 Attack (Including the boost from later generations, but moved to Attack)
notes: Can learn TM31 Brick Break Via TM

name: Cranidos
flavorText: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
abilityNotes: *Sheer Force is now a standard ability

name: Rampardos
flavorText: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.
abilityNotes: *Sheer Force is now a standard ability

name: Shieldon
flavorText: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

name: Bastiodon
flavorText: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.

name: Burmy
flavorText: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

name: Wormadam
flavorText: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

name: Vespiquen
flavorText: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

abilityNotes: *Water Veil is now a standard ability

name: Cherubi
flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

name: Cherrim
flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.

name: Shellos
flavorText: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

name: Gastrodon
flavorText: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”

name: Drifblim
flavorText: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

name: Buneary
flavorText: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”

name: Glameow
flavorText: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
notes: Now evolves into Purugly at Level 34

name: Purugly
flavorText: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.

name: Chingling
flavorText: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

name: Stunky
flavorText: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

name: Skuntank
flavorText: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
statChangeNote: +4 HP, -22 Attack, +8 Defense, +28 Special Attack, +9 Special Defense, +3 Speed

name: Bronzor
flavorText: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

name: Bonsly
flavorText: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.

name: Mime Jr.
flavorText: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.

name: Happiny
flavorText: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.

name: Chatot
flavorText: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Gible
flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

name: Gabite
flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
abilityNotes: *Rough Skin is now a standard ability

name: Garchomp
flavorText: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
abilityNotes: *Rough Skin is now a standard ability

name: Munchlax
flavorText: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Riolu
flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: Lucario
flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.
abilityNotes: *Sand Force is now a standard ability

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
abilityNotes: *Sand Force is now a standard ability

name: Skorupi
flavorText: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.

name: Drapion
flavorText: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.
abilityNotes: *Poison Touch is now a standard ability

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
abilityNotes: *Poison Touch is now a standard ability

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Finneon
flavorText: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

name: Lumineon
flavorText: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with Lanturn.
statChangeNote: -10 Attack, +4 Defense, +20 Special Attack, +16 Special Defense

name: Mantyke
flavorText: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with Remoraid.

name: Snover
flavorText: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
notes: Now evolves into Abomasnow at level 34

name: Abomasnow
flavorText: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

name: Weavile
flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.
notes: No Idea

name: Magnezone
flavorText: A group tried to use scientific means to make Magnezone evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.

name: Lickilicky
flavorText: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

name: Rhyperior
flavorText: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

name: Electivire
flavorText: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.
abilityNotes: *Vital Spirit is now a standard ability

name: Magmortar
flavorText: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
abilityNotes: *Vital Spirit is now a standard ability

name: Togekiss
flavorText: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
abilityNotes: *Super Luck is now a standard ability

name: Yanmega
flavorText: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

name: Leafeon
flavorText: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

name: Glaceon
flavorText: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
statChangeNote: Speed and Special Defense have switched

name: Gliscor
flavorText: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.
abilityNotes: *Poison Heal is now a standard ability

name: Mamoswine
flavorText: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.
abilityNotes: *Thick Fat is now a standard ability

name: Porygon-Z
flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

name: Gallade
flavorText: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

name: Probopass
flavorText: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Dusknoir
flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Froslass
flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
abilityNotes: *Cursed Body is now a standard ability

name: Rotom
flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

name: Palkia
flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia’s every breath.

name: Heatran
flavorText: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.

name: Cresselia

name: Phione
flavorText: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Manaphy
flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Darkrai
flavorText: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

name: Arceus
flavorText: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.
